name: Makassar

queries.query: peta bidang tanah Makassar Kantor Pertanahan Kota Makassar BHUMI ATR BPN persil
queries.scope: Find Makassar-specific land-office evidence and a public parcel service.
queries.result: The official ATR/BPN Makassar land-office domain publishes city-specific land-measurement and Peta Bidang Tanah (PBT) processing information, establishing a local cadastral registry custodian. The BHUMI public map catalog exposes the Bidang Tanah layer (umum:Persil) with extent including Makassar; however, its public proxy WFS query returned HTTP 403, so no city parcel feature or full geometry was verified.
queries.executionMethod: Indonesian-language search, official local land-office source review, public BHUMI catalog and bounded WFS test.

queries.query: Makassar official land office cadastral parcel registry Peta Bidang Tanah public GIS
queries.scope: Cross-check city land-office custody and whether public vector access is available.
queries.result: Makassar’s official land-office site confirms PBT parcel-measurement workflows. BHUMI documents parcel datasets and the city-wide national layer extent, but its client WFS proxy denied the bounded public query; no Makassar feature was returned.
queries.executionMethod: English-language search plus direct public portal/catalog queries.

technicalBlocker: City registry exists; public BHUMI catalog exposes a national parcel layer and client code uses WFS, but the bounded request to the official viewer’s public feature proxy returned HTTP 403.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the national parcel layer returns any current Makassar parcel features when an approved browser origin is used; completeness, NIB semantics, and local layer coverage.
